in_marathi.name: Ardhanaari
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ardhanaari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ardhanaari is a name derived from Sanskrit, which translates to 'half-human, half-goddess'. In Hindu mythology, Ardhanaari is a representation of the God Shiva in the form of Ardhanarishvara – half male and half female, symbolizing the union of Shiva and Parvati.
